experiment: Browser MCP transport in/out, resolution and admission residual on R2-10's source (scripted COMP): attribution (Phase A), stdio floor (FIXTURE) and causal A/B (Phase B)
hypothesis: COMP's MCP transport in/out decomposes into (i) an IRREDUCIBLE stdio floor (pipe syscalls plus framing for the exact payload bytes), (ii) Driver-side serialize/write cost that grows with payload size and (iii) caller-side Python MCP client read/parse/validate cost. At least one part beyond the floor can be deleted without changing outputs. Resolution and the admission residual split the same way into a floor and deletable work.

transport_in_out.c_in.prep: call_send -> c.writer_got (RecDriver, run.Driver.call, ClientSession.send_request, memory-stream hop to the stdin writer)
transport_in_out.pipe_in: c.req_written -> mcp.line_read (pipe + Driver stdin read wake)
transport_in_out.d_out.post: dispatch.exit, (<tool>, dispatch_exit|invoke_end), rt.*, sdk.*, mcp.invoke_end, mcp.conformed, mcp.handled, (mcp:*, handler_end) -> mcp.serialize_start
transport_in_out.d_out.write: mcp.serialized, (mcp:*, serialize_done) -> mcp.write_done (write_all into the stdout BufWriter)
transport_in_out.pipe_out: mcp.written, (mcp:*, response_written) -> c.first_byte (pipe + caller reader wake)
transport_in_out.c_out.route: c.parsed -> c.result_model_start (memory streams: reader -> session receive loop -> request stream; send_request wake)
transport_in_out.c_out.validate: client_validate_start -> client_validate_end (R2-10 component client_validation: compiled output validator)
transport_in_out.c_out.return: c.result_model_done / client_validate_end -> call_return (run.Driver.call result checks, RecDriver bookkeeping)

admission_residual.adm.inner: mcp.admitted, identity_applied, session_begun, timer_started, (mcp:*, handler_start), inner_classified, inner_tools_list_built, inner_validation_skipped -> mcp.inner_validated

floors.irreducible_floor: F0 (part i): pipe syscalls + newline framing + one stdlib json.loads of the exact recorded bytes (+ stdlib json.dumps of the request), same pipes, same payload sizes per call
floors.client_stack_floor: F1: the same Python MCP client stack and pipe setup against a zero-work server; F1 - F0 = part (iii) as replayed
floors.interpretation: the spec's floor harness runs the same client stack (F1). Using F1 as the IRREDUCIBLE floor would class every caller-side cost as IRREDUCIBLE without a causal test, so this lane uses the stricter rule: caller-side sub-spans are compared with their F0 counterpart (prep/route/result_model/validate/return have F0 value 0; serialize = F0 json.dumps; write+pipe_in = F0 write->server read; pipe_out+frame = F0 server write->frame complete; parse = F0 json.loads). Driver-side sub-spans have floor 0 (the floor server does no parse, admission, dispatch or serialization), except d_out.write + d_out.flush, whose floor is the floor server's own read->write time (one write(2) of the same bytes). Values under the spec's literal F1 floor are reported alongside.
floors.per_task: floor per task = sum over the trial's in-T calls (same labels) of the per-call floor from the replay of that trial's frames

statistics.unit: per-task sums over in-T calls; means over valid trials per class; seeded bootstrap over trials (seed 20261003, 10000 resamples, percentile 95% CI); paired arms: bootstrap over rounds

statistics.coverage: per trial 1 - (time labelled other.* / c_other / R2-10 unattributed with no B-05 label) / T_runner; required >= 0.97 on every valid Phase A trial (R2-10 coverage also reported)

phase_B_design.secondary: paired T_runner and T_oracle differences with CI (reported; a candidate whose T_runner CI lies entirely above 0 is a regression and fails)
phase_B_design.N4a: 5 per class in each candidate arm (R2-10 N4a: node replaced between bind and dispatch): refused browser_ref_stale with effect refused semantics, one fresh observation, verified
phase_B_design.negative: 10 malformed response frames (harness/b05_floor.MALFORMED) through every caller-side parser variant and the default: each must be rejected (the call raises; no CallToolResult returned); validator variants additionally get 10 schema-invalid structured results that must be rejected with the same error text as the default
phase_B_design.equivalence: caller arms: for 100% of in-trial tools/call responses (raw frames captured per trial), the candidate's decoded output equals the default path's on the same bytes under canonical JSON (json.dumps sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii False) of CallToolResult.model_dump(mode='json', by_alias=True, exclude_none=True), and the validation decision and error text are identical; Driver knob arms: frames byte-identical to the default on the same response (unit test) and identical receipt shapes

gates.DELETED (KEEP): saving >= 0.5 ms per-task mean with a 95% CI excluding 0, validity 100%, equivalence 100%, controls pass (N4a, negative, default-off smoke)
gates.IRREDUCIBLE: the sub-span's corrected per-task CI overlaps its floor value, or every tested candidate fails
gates.OWNER_DECISION: the deletion works but changes the public output contract
gates.IRREDUCIBLE (invariant): lane rule: a resolution sub-span that is exactly one CDP request whose result the ref-freshness invariant requires at dispatch time (frame proof, node resolve, editability check; #73/#93, FIX-01) is IRREDUCIBLE by invariant (SOURCE + BENCHMARK), with its corrected cost reported
gates.BELOW_GATE: lane rule: a sub-span whose corrected excess over its floor has a 95% CI upper bound below 0.5 ms per task cannot meet the DELETED gate even if fully deleted; it is labelled BELOW_GATE and the E2 share is reported both with BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED
gates.validity: 100% verified (oracle exact match, exactly one completion mutation, runner verified) and forced path per arm for DELETED; every failure stays in the denominators

e2_recompute: per class on B5: R2-10 COMP component table (R2-10 code) with the verdicts updated from this packet (transport, admission, resolution and, if tested, client_validation via their sub-spans; the R2-10 'unattributed' intervals left by R2-04 tool marks are labelled by B-05 sub-spans); untested share = UNTESTED ms / mean T_runner, raw and corrected; target < 5% per class
forced_path: clicks: dom_event route through the Driver CDP engine (candidate input_route dom_event, receipt route dom, click.cdp_send mark inside the call when marks are on); typing: browser_type, receipt route trusted_input. Marks-off arms check the caller-visible part (receipt route, input_route, driver_env_exp knobs: admission cache, settle 0 on fill) and cannot show click.cdp_send
oracle: independent, target-owned: the jev-use fixture server state with its CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal, re-read every 2 ms by a harness thread (fill submitted == token; toggle checked; modal opened and modal)
E4: 0 stale-ref dispatches, 0 duplicate mutations, 0 unverified successes, refusals returned as refused, 0 blind replays, in every arm and control
